name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 21 No 37

clue.text: Start exchanging halves, to compensate
Beat standard sort of cake
One taken in by older PC to give information?
Mingle, hugging new, lively girl
The same soldiers knock back what’s pulled at opening time
Hooligan harbours a yen for organisation
Love that’s not affected by negative sign
Mexican farm-hand managed nasty chore
I cover the surface of a pot all over in Indian language
Revolutionary teacher assesses oral
Bob is queasy — what’s in that rich soup?
Diamonds and money — temptation for youngster?
Greeting traveller from across the sea
Small advance protecting province from outdated culture?
Curse criminal that’s very determined
Lord of the jungle
Govt. Dept. has painting put up — an original print
Prove a sun may explode? So it does!
Tiresome expenditure of effort
Fellow intoning “freedom” on the gallows? It’s silly gossip
Somewhat caustic, start off conversation with a row
Having a lot of traffic? That’s lucky!
Chestnut, say, runs round ring as winner
Clarify tricky clue I’d got stuck into?
He’s entitled to occupy new room he refurbished
Pre-prepared envelope carrying special label is worth buying
Gaze, half abstracted — very much a fanatic
Put down pen, having change of heart
Beast of burden turning up a sheltered street
